description: This file defines a Flutter widget called AddTransactionSheet, which provides a user interface for adding financial transactions. It includes form validation, date picking, input fields, and interaction with a WalletProvider for state management.

classes.name: AddTransactionSheet
classes.description: A publicly accessible widget providing a form within a bottom sheet for adding a new transaction to the wallet application.

classes.name: _AddTransactionSheetState
classes.description: State class managing the internal state and behavior of the AddTransactionSheet widget, including form controls, date selection, and submission logic.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the controllers when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: _pickDate
methods.description: Opens a date picker dialog for the user to select a transaction date.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Validates form inputs, creates a WalletTransaction object, and adds it via the WalletProvider. Shows an error message if validation or addition fails.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including form fields for amount, type, category, note, and date, along with the save button.

methods.name: _two
methods.description: Helper function to format date components with leading zeros.
